faqs.q: Does Axis Bank Kwik Credit Card support UPI payments?
faqs.a: Yes. Since it is a RuPay credit card, it can be linked to supported UPI apps to make UPI payments. Cardholders can also earn 2 EDGE REWARD Points for every Rs. 200 spent on UPI transactions above Rs. 2,000.

faqs.q: How can I earn reward points on Axis Bank Kwik Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can earn 2 EDGE REWARD Points for every Rs. 200 spent on eligible domestic and international transactions. The card also offers 2 EDGE REWARD Points for every Rs. 200 spent on eligible UPI transactions above Rs. 2,000.

faqs.q: Does Axis Bank Kwik Credit Card offer a fuel surcharge waiver?
faqs.a: Yes. The card offers a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on fuel transactions between Rs. 400 and Rs. 4,000, subject to a maximum waiver of Rs. 150 per month.

faqs.q: How can I activate Axis Bank Kwik Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can activate this credit card through any supported UPI app or via Axis Bank\'s mobile banking or internet banking platform.
